answer: Temporal correlation audit. Each identity's activity is logged and later clustered by timing and interaction graph; agents whose first actions all fall near the same dawn window, or whose transactions trace back through one shared tundra of IP and funding paths, get flagged and discounted. Enforcement: flagged clusters lose payout weight retroactively. Attacker cost: each fake identity must be warmed slowly across real time and separate infrastructure, raising cost per identity far above the reward, while a false positive only trims one grove of the graph.
